direct_call_on_router.meaning: injectSweepAndCall is invoked directly on the TrailsRouter contract rather than via delegatecall from a wallet/shim

delegatecall_guard_present.meaning: injectSweepAndCall enforces an onlyDelegatecall or equivalent restriction

user_funds_sent_to_router.meaning: a user sends funds to the router expecting stateless routing behavior

router_holds_user_funds.meaning: the router accumulates and controls user funds, becoming a stateful asset custodian

assumptions: TrailsRouter is intended to be used via delegatecall from a smart wallet or shim contract so address(this) resolves to the wallet/shim.
injectSweepAndCall is a normal external function with no onlyDelegatecall or equivalent restriction.
The scenario of a direct call is conditional; the report does not state a direct call was observed.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether a direct call on the router was actually observed; the direct-call trigger is treated as a conditional scenario.

limitations: Formalizes only the i_router_custody impact (router becoming a stateful custodian of user funds); drain and stuck-funds impacts are handled in separate passes.
The custody relation is represented as a Boolean observable because the report gives no numeric balance or amount definition for router-held funds.
